notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to green is at least 7.
description:
Activate Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx by paying {2} and tapping it, adding at least seven {G}.
Cast Sprout Swarm with buyback by paying {4}{G}, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token and returning Sprout Swarm to your hand.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Saproling, untapping Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx.
Repeat.
